            <svg viewBox="0 0 500 500" role="presentation">
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="nexusFlareHot" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fffbd0"/>
                  <stop offset=".24" stop-color="#ffe06a"/>
                  <stop offset=".58" stop-color="#ff8b24"/>
                  <stop offset=".84" stop-color="#ff421b"/>
                  <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b91412" stop-opacity=".15"/>
                </linearGradient>
                <filter id="nexusPlasmaDistort" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
                  <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".006 .014" numOctaves="3" seed="17" result="noise">
                    <animate attributeName="baseFrequency" values=".006 .014;.008 .018;.006 .014" dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
                  </feTurbulence>
                  <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="noise" scale="15" xChannelSelector="R" yChannelSelector="G"/>
                </filter>
                <filter id="nexusFlareGlow" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="260%" height="260%">
                  <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="blur"/>
                  <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
                </filter>
              </defs>

              <!-- thin irregular corona; no evenly spaced spikes -->
              <circle class="nexus-corona c1" cx="250" cy="250" r="127"/>
              <circle class="nexus-corona c2" cx="250" cy="250" r="134"/>

<script>
(()=>{
  const layer=document.getElementById('coreNoiseLayer');
  if(!layer)return;

  const pool=[];
  for(let n=0;n<120;n++){
    const line=document.createElement('span');
    line.className='core-noise-line';
    layer.appendChild(line);
    pool.push(line);
  }

  let runId=0, stopTimer=0, waveTimers=[];

  function clearTimers(){
    waveTimers.forEach(clearTimeout);
    waveTimers=[];
    clearTimeout(stopTimer);
  }

  function resetLine(line){
    line.style.transition='none';
    line.style.opacity='0';
    line.style.left='50%';
    line.style.top='50%';
    line.style.width='0';
    line.style.height='1px';
    line.style.transform='translate3d(-50%,0,0) scaleX(.08)';
  }

  function clearLines(){
    pool.forEach(resetLine);
  }

  function pickWaveMood(){
    const moods=[
      {pairs:11, jitter:56, len:.15, lenVar:.24, alpha:.42, alphaVar:.30, dur:520, durVar:260, travel:.20, travelVar:.22, scale:1.04, scaleVar:.48, cool:.08, thickBias:.68},
      {pairs:17, jitter:82, len:.12, lenVar:.22, alpha:.34, alphaVar:.24, dur:300, durVar:210, travel:.16, travelVar:.28, scale:1.34, scaleVar:.68, cool:.18, thickBias:.78},
      {pairs:9, jitter:46, len:.24, lenVar:.32, alpha:.50, alphaVar:.30, dur:640, durVar:360, travel:.26, travelVar:.34, scale:1.18, scaleVar:.56, cool:.05, thickBias:.52},
      {pairs:14, jitter:70, len:.18, lenVar:.26, alpha:.38, alphaVar:.34, dur:430, durVar:300, travel:.22, travelVar:.30, scale:1.24, scaleVar:.62, cool:.28, thickBias:.64}
    ];
    return moods[Math.floor(Math.random()*moods.length)];
  }

  function fireWave(id, waveIndex, mood){
    if(id!==runId)return;

    const w=Math.max(layer.clientWidth,260);
    const pairs=mood.pairs+Math.floor(Math.random()*5);
    const base=waveIndex*20;

    for(let p=0;p<pairs;p++){
      const leftLine=pool[(base+p*2)%pool.length];
      const rightLine=pool[(base+p*2+1)%pool.length];
      const spread=(Math.random()-.5);
      const y=50 + spread*mood.jitter + Math.sin((waveIndex+p)*1.7)*7;
      const len=w*(mood.len+Math.random()*mood.lenVar);
      const alpha=mood.alpha+Math.random()*mood.alphaVar;
      const dur=mood.dur+Math.floor(Math.random()*mood.durVar);
      const delay=p*(5+Math.random()*5)+Math.random()*34;
      const warm=Math.random()>mood.cool;
      const color=warm
        ? `linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,245,170,0),rgba(255,${172+Math.floor(Math.random()*68)},${42+Math.floor(Math.random()*78)},${alpha}),rgba(255,76,22,0))`
        : `linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(95,220,255,0),rgba(${125+Math.floor(Math.random()*70)},230,255,${alpha*.82}),rgba(95,220,255,0))`;

      const leftTravel=w*(mood.travel+waveIndex*.043+Math.random()*mood.travelVar);
      const rightTravel=w*(mood.travel+waveIndex*.043+Math.random()*mood.travelVar);
      const thickness=Math.random()<mood.thickBias ? 1 : (Math.random()<.9 ? 2 : 3);
      const centerGap=7+Math.random()*15;

      [leftLine,rightLine].forEach((line,idx)=>{
        line.style.transition='none';
        line.style.left='50%';
        line.style.top=(y + (idx ? .9 : -.9) + (Math.random()-.5)*1.4).toFixed(2)+'%';
        line.style.width=len.toFixed(1)+'px';
        line.style.height=thickness+'px';
        line.style.background=color;
        line.style.opacity=(alpha*.58).toFixed(2);
        line.style.transform=`translate3d(calc(-50% ${idx ? '+' : '-'} ${centerGap.toFixed(1)}px),0,0) scaleX(.045)`;
      });

      const t=setTimeout(()=>{
        if(id!==runId)return;

        leftLine.style.transition=`transform ${dur}ms cubic-bezier(.08,.78,.14,1),opacity ${dur+260}ms linear`;
        rightLine.style.transition=`transform ${dur}ms cubic-bezier(.08,.78,.14,1),opacity ${dur+260}ms linear`;

        leftLine.style.transform=`translate3d(calc(-50% - ${leftTravel.toFixed(1)}px),0,0) scaleX(${(mood.scale+Math.random()*mood.scaleVar).toFixed(2)})`;
        rightLine.style.transform=`translate3d(calc(-50% + ${rightTravel.toFixed(1)}px),0,0) scaleX(${(mood.scale+Math.random()*mood.scaleVar).toFixed(2)})`;

        leftLine.style.opacity='0';
        rightLine.style.opacity='0';
      },delay);
      waveTimers.push(t);
    }
  }

  window.runCoreNoise=(duration=2100)=>{
    const id=++runId;
    const mood=pickWaveMood();
    clearTimers();
    clearLines();
    layer.classList.add('active');

    const waves=6+Math.floor(Math.random()*5);
    const gap=120+Math.floor(Math.random()*95);
    for(let i=0;i<waves;i++){
      const t=setTimeout(()=>fireWave(id,i,mood),i*gap);
      waveTimers.push(t);
    }

    stopTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
      if(id!==runId)return;
      clearLines();
      layer.classList.remove('active');
    },Math.max(duration,waves*gap+480));
  };
})();
</script>

  <script>/* 版143：漢字変換の辞書（Mozc 辞書 BSD ライセンスより一部抽出）は、かな入力で初めて使うときに読み込む（起動を軽くする） */
Object.defineProperty(window,"MOZC_DICT",{configurable:true,get(){let v={};try{v=JSON.parse(document.getElementById("mozcDict").textContent);}catch(_){}Object.defineProperty(window,"MOZC_DICT",{value:v,writable:true,configurable:true});return v;}});
</script>
